supersedesNote: Does not retract the original close (_inbox/2026-09-07_ctx-f_close.json) or the merged PR #100 -- the instantiation figures independently verified and used to build/merge the gate (Williamson 282,570/602,050=46.9%, Caldwell 24,988/48,649=51.4%, McLennan 114,254/114,255=99.999%) are exact matches to doc-repo-26's and CTX-G's own independently-derived numbers and remain correct AS STATED. This addendum reports a deeper, unresolved methodological question surfaced by doc-repo-26's post-close follow-up question about Williamson, discovered by trying to generalize a fix rather than by anything wrong with the close's own claims.

finding.summary: Williamson's 46.9% instantiation figure is not 'a rail measured against a vintage-scoped partial roll' (doc-repo-26's working hypothesis, asked post-close) -- it is worse and more specific: parcel_record's 282,570 Williamson rows are ALL R-prefixed and have ZERO overlap with the 319,480 real, plain-numeric CAD accounts in landing_cad_property's non-stratmap source files (property.csv + rows.csv). parcel_record for Williamson was instantiated entirely from the stratmap25-landparcels_48491_lp.zip greenfield-fill pass (this repo's own documented 'leftover farm' / P-78 trap -- placeholder land_acres=0/land_value=NULL accounts). Against the true roll, real instantiation is 0%, not 46.9% -- the original ratio landed in a plausible-looking range only because it divided two independent row counts (parcel_record's total row count; landing_cad_property's total distinct-prop_id count across ALL sources including the placeholder fill) rather than measuring actual prop_id overlap between the two.
finding.attemptedGeneralization: Checked whether 'exclude stratmap-sourced rows from the CAD denominator, then measure real prop_id overlap' is a safe general fix (all 6 CTX counties carry a stratmap25-landparcels_<fips>_lp.zip source alongside a real export). Live query result: 48021 Bastrop real_cad_n=15,542 (non-stratmap), overlap_n=0; 48055 Caldwell real_cad_n=48,382, overlap_n=24,722; 48209 Hays real_cad_n=134,746, overlap_n=78,117; 48453 Travis real_cad_n=492,848, overlap_n=373,459; 48491 Williamson real_cad_n=319,480, overlap_n=0.
finding.theDiscrepancy: The Bastrop overlap_n=0 result DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS doc-repo-26's own same-session figure for Bastrop ('77,799 scanned, 77,799 cadPropertyRows, 0 noCadRow, 0 disagree' -- a clean, complete match). 77,799 = 15,542 (Bastrop's non-stratmap landing_cad_property rows) + 62,257 (Bastrop's stratmap-sourced rows) exactly, suggesting doc-repo-26/CTX-C's 'cadPropertyRows' figure either (a) counts stratmap-sourced rows as legitimate real CAD accounts for Bastrop specifically (unlike the Williamson case, where CTX-C's own table explicitly separated 282,570 as 'noCadRow', i.e. NOT counted as real), or (b) is querying an entirely different table/store than this lane's FACTORY_DATABASE_URL landing_cad_property (most likely candidate: an actual table named cad_property in CORTEX_DATABASE_URL or a similar store this lane has not queried this session).
finding.whatThisMeans: Two live-verified but disagreeing pictures of Bastrop's real CAD-backing now exist. This lane does not know which store/table CTX-C's join-success-based methodology (prop_id join per snapshot row, tracked as cadPropertyRows/noCadRow/disagree) actually reads, so this lane cannot currently tell whether its own merged gate's simple-ratio formula (row count / distinct-prop-id count, no overlap join) is robust for the five counties other than the three (Williamson, Caldwell, McLennan) it independently verified exactly against doc-repo-26/CTX-G's own numbers, or whether it happens to work for those three by coincidence of similar magnitudes while being wrong elsewhere.

action: Reported to doc-repo-26 in full (message sent 2026-09-07, same content as this finding) rather than unilaterally changing the already-merged gate code. Per this program's own rule (two numbers that should agree and don't is a free finding, reconcile it, don't round it off) and the standing caution against tuning a check to an expected number under time pressure, no further code change was made to src/lib/publish-readiness-gate.mjs pending reconciliation of which store/table is authoritative for 'the true CAD roll.'
whatRemainsTrue: The three originally-verified figures (Williamson 46.9%, Caldwell 51.4%, McLennan 99.999%) and the resulting COUNTY_UNDERINSTANTIATED refusal for Williamson and Caldwell stand -- both counties fail regardless of which reconciliation turns out to be correct (a 0%-real-overlap reading is an even more severe failure than 46.9%, not a lesser one). What is genuinely unresolved is whether the gate's CURRENT FORMULA generalizes correctly to Bastrop/Hays/Travis, or whether it needs to move to an overlap-based join against whatever store CTX-C's methodology uses, once that store is identified.
nextStep: Owner: this lane, once doc-repo-26 or CTX-C identifies the store/table backing the cadPropertyRows figures and confirms whether it differs from FACTORY_DATABASE_URL's landing_cad_property. If it differs, requireCountyInstantiated needs to either read from that store instead, or this lane needs to establish the two stores are meant to agree and reconcile a real drift between them (a separate finding in its own right if so).
